title: Myth: Bitcoin Difficulty Adjusts Every Day
hook: Myth: Bitcoin's difficulty changes every day.

scenes.narration: It is recalculated every two thousand sixteen blocks, about two weeks.
Clients compare the actual time with the two-week goal.
One adjustment never changes the target by more than a factor of four.
Blocks keep coming in between, but the difficulty stays put until the next mark.

cta: Did you think daily? Tell me in the comments, and the link is on my channel page.
description_body: Difficulty adjusts about every two weeks, not daily, and only within limits.
